test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What theme was decided to celebrate the second ‘International Day of Yoga’ in India?

options.text: Yoga for the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals

solution:
The correct answer is __**Yoga for the achievement of Sustainable Development Goals.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Themes of International Yoga Day :

 
 
• 2015: Yoga for Harmony and Peace
 
• **2016: Yoga for the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals**
 
• 2017: Yoga for Health
 
• 2018: Yoga for Peace
 
• 2019: Yoga for Heart
 
• 2020: Yoga at Home and Yoga with Family
 
• 2021: Yoga For Wellness
 
• 2022: Yoga for Humanity
 
 
 
• 2023: **Yoga for Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam**
 
• **2024: Yoga for Self and Society**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• On 11th December 2014, the United Nations proclaimed 21 June__ as the International Day of Yoga by resolution 69/131.
 
• The idea of the International Day of Yoga was proclaimed by the current Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi, during his speech at the United Nations General Assembly in 2014.
 
• International Yoga Day is celebrated every year on 21 June to raise awareness worldwide about the benefits of Yoga in Daily Life.
 
• June 21, also called the summer solstice, is the longest day of the year.
